dune-rock-green.name: Dune Rock Green work shoes
dune-rock-green.html:
Work high shoes from the Dune line made with a special NHP (High Performance Nylon) compound composed of EVA, with the specific function of cushioning impacts on the foot. The distinctive feature of Dune safety shoes is their highly stable sole with excellent grip, which guarantees greater safety on all types of terrain.

These safety shoes also feature an abrasion-resistant upper, rubber reinforcement on the toe and TPU reinforcement in areas of high wear to ensure protection and durability. The tongue with bellows limits the passage of dust inside the shoe. 

Dune Rock Green work high shoes are the ideal solution for those looking for a comfortable and lightweight work shoe that offers comfort, cushioning and protection at the same time.

dune-jaq.name: Dune Jaq work shoes
dune-jaq.html:
The new Dune Jaq work shoes are the ideal solution for those looking for a comfortable and lightweight shoe, which immediately feels elastic, soft and cushioning, thanks to the innovative NHP midsole that develops an Ultra Rebound effect during walking.

The special NHP (Nylon High Performances) compound made of EVA, with which the midsole and the footbed of the Dune shoes are made, has been specially designed to ensure a high level of cushioning, flexibility and maximum comfort.

Dune Jaq safety shoes are ESD certified for electrostatic dissipation and are designed for those who work in working environments with electronically controlled machines, flammable liquids and gases, microchip, production of electrical components and in several laboratories at risk. In addition to the new midsole, the work shoes of the new line Kapriol Dune are equipped with a resistant non-slip rubber outsole high-grip, the carbon fiber toe and the anti-puncture sole high flexibility. 

Dune Jaq safety shoes are available in four colours: yellow, green, grey and the new pink colour.

makalu.html:

harness-alfa5.name: Alfa 5
harness-alfa5.html:
EN 361 - EN 358 - EN 813 five attachment multi-purpose fall arrest harness, with two positioning loops, padded leg loops and practical tool loops, for high comfort and light weight performance. The harness's adjustable back elastics make hanging work more comfortable.

The Alfa 5 professional fall arrest harness allows connection between ventral and sternal attachment without the use of a connector and is equipped with a comfortable, breathable ergonomic backrest with adjustable shoulder straps, ensuring better operator comfort during hanging. 

The Alfa 5 multi-purpose harness is ideal for double rope work and long-term suspension.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

  • Dorsal fall arrest attachment (A)
  • Sternal fall arrest attachment (A)
  • Ventral suspension attachment
  • Ergonomic, padded and breathable back with reflective inserts and adjustable shoulder straps
  • Adjustable rear elastic straps
  • Padded lumbar belt
  • PVC-coated tool loops
  • Two foldable side positioning rings
  • Padded and adjustable leg loops with quick-release buckles
  • Aluminium buckles and rings
  • Standard EN 361 - EN 358 - EN 813

harness-beta3-front-back.name: Beta 3
harness-beta3-front-back.html:
Fall arrest safety harness with 3 attachments: one dorsal (A) and two frontal (A) attachments that can also be used individually. Thanks to the double sternal ring, the Beta 3 harness is ideal for use on ladders equipped with a fall arrest system. 

The fall arrest harness is equipped with practical adjustable shoulder straps and leg loops, making it extremely comfortable and easy to wear. 

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS 

  • One dorsal fall arrest attachment (A)
  • Two front fall arrest attachments (A) that can also be used individually
  • Adjustable braces
  • Adjustable leg loops
  • Thigh strap
  • EN 361 standard

harness-beta3-combi.name: Beta 3
harness-beta3-combi.html:
Fall arrest safety harness with 3 attachments: one dorsal (A) and two frontal (A) attachments that can also be used individually. Thanks to the double sternal ring, the Beta 3 harness is ideal for use on ladders equipped with a fall arrest system. 

The fall arrest harness is equipped with practical adjustable shoulder straps and leg loops, making it extremely comfortable and easy to wear. 

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS 

  • One dorsal fall arrest attachment (A)
  • Two front fall arrest attachments (A) that can also be used individually
  • Adjustable braces
  • Adjustable leg loops
  • Thigh strap
  • EN 361 standard

harness-gamma2.name: Gamma 2
harness-gamma2.html:
Harness for work at height with 2 attachments, one dorsal fall arrest (A) and one sternal fall arrest (A) made by connecting two attachments (A/2) together via a connector. 

The Gamma 2 harness enables many work-at-height activities to be carried out safely and is easy to put on thanks to the double adjustment of the shoulder straps and leg loops.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS 

  • Dorsal fall arrest attachment (A)
  • Two sternal fall arrest attachments (A/2) - connected together by a connector become fall arrest (A)
  • Adjustable braces
  • Adjustable leg loops
  • Thigh-piece strap
  • EN 361 standard

harness-basic-duo.name: Basic Duo
harness-basic-duo.html:
Two connector harness suitable for multiple activities at height. Easy to wear thanks to the double adjustment of shoulder straps and leg loops.

SPECIFICATIONS

  • Standard: EN 361
  • Back fall protection connector (A)
  • Two breast clasps (A/2) which, when linked to the connector, create a fall protection apparatus (A)
  • Polyester webbing
  • Adjustable leg loops
  • Leg loop fastener strap

suspension-seat.name: Suspension Seat
suspension-seat.html:
When applied to the harness, thanks to the large seat, it allows operators to remain in a comfortable position during suspended work. It is ideal for long-term suspension work. It is not a fall protection equipment.

SPECIFICS

  • Ideal for use with all harness types
  • Spacious and comfy seat to guarantee excellent stability
  • Adjustable straps
  • Rigid and non-deformable structure 
  • Two tools holder rings
  • Comes with snap hook art. 27989 (standard EN 362)

positioning-belt.name: Positioning Belt
positioning-belt.html:
The use of the positioning belt allows you to connect to an anchorage point and remain stable, allowing operators to work with their hands free in positions with little balance. To be used together with Beta 3, Gamma 2 and Basic Duo harnesses. This can not be used as a fall protection equipment. 

SPECIFICS

  • Standard: EN 358
  • Two side position rings
  • Lightweight, comfortable and adjustable
  • Breathable padding
  • Side tool carrier rings

lanyard-positioning-block.name: Adjustable positioning laynard with block system
lanyard-positioning-block.html:
Adjustable positioning lanyard with locking system complete with karabiner, connector and regulator.

  • Length 2 m
  • EN 358 standard

lanyard-positioning-adjustable.name: Lanyard adjustable positioning
lanyard-positioning-adjustable.html:
Adjustable positioning lanyard with a strong steel eyelet for strength and safety, adjustable via a light alloy ring. The sheathing on the fall arrest lanyard provides protection at the points of greatest friction. 

The Kapriol EN 358 compliant repositioning lanyard can be used with karabiners for attachment to harness positioning loops.

lanyard-positioning-absorber.html:
Adjustable positioning lanyard by means of a steel ring and particularly wear-resistant 12 mm diameter polyester rope. The adjustable fall arrest lanyard is equipped with a 56 mm wide-opening connector with practical safety lever. 

This positioning lanyard is equipped with an energy absorber with 32 mm polyamide webbing that reduces impact from falling, ideal for use on a platform.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

  • Connector with 56 mm opening and safety lever
  • Adjustment ring 
  • Energy absorber with 32 mm webbing and PE casing
  • 12 mm diameter rope
  • Length 1.5 m
  • Standard EN 355

  • Connector: steel
  • Adjusting ring: steel

lanyard-elastic-single.name: Fall protection elastic webbing one connector
lanyard-elastic-single.html:
EN 355 compliant elastic fall arrest lanyard with ferrule connector for attachment to the harness. This single-connector fall arrester lanyard with safety lever makes it easier for the operator to move around due to its small size. 

The elastic fall arrest lanyard is also equipped with an energy dissipator to absorb the force of impact in the event of a fall.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS 

  • Ferrule connector
  • Connector with 56mm opening and safety lever
  • Energy absorber with 32 mm webbing and PE containment cover
  • Length 2 m
  • EN 355 standard

MATERIAL

  • Connectors: steel 
  • Webbing: polyamide 
  • Containment casing: polyethylene

retractable-rekap-10m.name: 10 m retractable type device
retractable-rekap-10m.html:
A retractable type fall arrester with a 10 metre long galvanised steel rope and energy absorber, capable of a maximum load capacity of up to 120 kg and a breaking strength of 12 kN.

The retractable type fall arrester with shock-proof ABS protective cover can be used on both flat and sloping surfaces, for restraint and positioning purposes only, where there is no possibility of falling. Equipped with an energy absorber, the 10 m retractable device guarantees safety, autonomy and freedom of movement for the operator during use. 

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS 

  • Shockproof protective casing
  • Length 10 m
  • Breaking load 12 kN
  • Maximum load capacity 120 kg
  • Rope diameter 4.8 mm
  • Energy absorber
  • Horizontal use possible 
  • Standard EN 360

MATERIAL

  • Rope: galvanised steel 
  • Casing: shockproof ABS

retractable-20m.name: 20 m retractable type device
retractable-20m.html:
Retractable fall arrest device with galvanised wire rope with a length of 10-20 metres and a maximum load capacity of 140 kg. This fall arrest device can be used on flat or inclined surfaces for restraint and positioning purposes only, where there is no possibility of a fall.

The wire retractable type fall arrester guarantees a breaking load of 15 kN and is not certified for horizontal use, in the event of a fall the cable could break on sharp edges.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS 

  • Protective casing 
  • Breaking load 15 kN
  • Maximum load capacity 140 kg
  • Rope diameter 4 mm and length 10-20 m
  • Standard EN 360

MATERIAL

  • Rope: galvanised metal
  • Casing: shockproof ABS

retractable-6m.name: 6 m retractable type device
retractable-6m.html:
Compact and lightweight retractable type fall arrester consisting of a durable 6 metre long polyester webbing, impact-resistant plastic protective cover and practical swivel connector for attachment to the harness. The anchorage system by means of a swivel ring makes the fall arrest device extremely safe and comfortable, guaranteeing freedom of movement for the operator. 

The materials with which it is made, together with the fall indicator inserted in the attachment connector, make this Kapriol retractable type fall arrester particularly suitable for work at heights where there are covers or equipment sensitive to impact. 

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

  • 17 mm wide and 6 m long tape
  • Swivel connector for attachment to the harness 
  • Anchorage with swivel ring
  • Shock protective cover
  • Fall warning device inserted in the attachment connector
  • Breaking load 15 kN
  • Standard EN 360

MATERIAL

  • Tape: polyester  
  • Casing: shockproof ABS

retractable-2m.name: 2 m retractable type device
retractable-2m.html:
Compact and lightweight retractable type fall arrester with impact-resistant ABS protective cover and strong 46 mm polyester webbing with energy absorber.

The EN 360 compliant 2 metre retractable type fall arrester can be used in working conditions with fall factor 2 thanks to the webbing locking mechanism that stops the fall, suitable for work on scaffolding or maintenance work in confined spaces (e.g. aerial masters). The Kapriol retractable type fall arrester's swivel ring anchorage system guarantees safety, autonomy and freedom of movement during use. 

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS 

  • Webbing with 46 mm and 1.65 m length 
  • Energy dissipator applied to the webbing
  • Shockproof protective cover
  • Anchorage with swivel ring
  • Usable in working conditions with fall factor 2
  • Breaking load 15 kN
  • Standard EN 360

MATERIAL 

  • Casing: shockproof ABS
  • Webbing: polyester

fall-device-easy.name: Easy fall protection equipment
fall-device-easy.html:
An anti-fall device on a 12 mm diameter and 15 m long Kernmantle rope equipped with a strong steel connector and self-locking mechanism. This fall arrest rope is equipped with an energy absorber with webbing and a containment casing to reduce the force of impact in the event of a fall. 

The Easy rope fall arrest device, certified for horizontal use on sharp edges, is particularly suitable for work on pitches and pylons, ensuring the operator can move freely and maintain balance in unstable conditions.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

  • 12 mm diameter and 15 m long Kernmantle rope
  • Self-locking steel mechanism
  • Connector 
  • Energy absorber with 32 mm webbing and PE casing
  • Certified for horizontal use on sharp edges
  • Standard EN 353-2

  • Rope: polyester
  • Connector: steel
  • Webbing: polyamide

rescue-kit-scaffolding-full.name: Abseiling rescue and recovery kit
rescue-kit-scaffolding-full.html:
EN 341 standard rescue kit for scaffolding consisting of CE certified fall protection PPE, complete with PVC backpack resistant to UV rays and impact. 

The rescue kit is equipped with a hoist that can be used in two ways:

  • on scaffolding with one rescuer by lifting the victim
  • in a vacuum with two rescuers by releasing the lanyard and lowering to the ground

ice-spray.name: Ice spray
ice-spray.html:
Instant ice spray in 200 ml can used to relieve pain caused by trauma, bruising, falls or sprains in cases where cryotherapy and cold treatment are required. Its anesthetic effect, induced by the cooling of the bruised part, allows a prompt resumption of activity. 

The spray ice can is a medical device with CE marking free of CFCs (does not harm ozone) and is equipped with valve and protective cap.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS 

  • 200 ml in size 
  • size 50x50x170
  • valve and protective cap
  • Free of CFC
  • medical device CE mark

ice-pack.name: Pack de glace
ice-pack.html:
Instant ice in disposable bag is a medical device with CE marking functional to relieve pain caused by trauma, bruises, falls or sprains through the application of cold.

After having crushed the bubble contained inside the bag and having shaken it well to mix the contents, an instant cooling process develops immediately, which guarantees a time of use of about 25/30 minutes depending on the outside temperature. The anaesthetic effect of instant ice, induced by cooling of the injured part, promotes a prompt resumption of activity. 

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

  • single use envelope
  • weight 230 gr
  • size 160x130x25 mm
  • medical device CE mark
